name: M1A2 Abrams
axis_orientation: the front-end is the muzzle/nose/bow, the rear-end is the engine deck/exhaust
operating_principle: The M1A2 Abrams main battle tank is a tracked vehicle powered by a 1,500 HP gas turbine engine, with a 120mm smoothbore cannon as its primary armament. It uses a combination of armor, firepower, and mobility to achieve its mission objectives.

components.description: The main structural body of the tank, providing protection and support for the crew and systems.
The rotating structure that houses the main gun and crew stations.
The engine and transmission system that powers the tank.
The tracks, wheels, and suspension system that enable the tank to move.
The system that controls the main gun and secondary armament.
The guns and ammunition used by the tank.
The combination of armor types used to protect the tank.
The station that provides the commander with situational awareness.
